title: Finite-type extraordinary pullback of potential complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime and $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$. Let $f:Y\to X$ be a compactifiable finite-type morphism between Noetherian excellent schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-exc-excellent-ring]. Let $\delta_X$ be a dimension function and let $(K,(p_x))$ be a pinned potential dualizing complex on $(X,\delta_X)$ [def-per-potential-dualizing]. Let $f^!$ denote the right adjoint on bounded-below etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] to ordinary compact-support direct image $Rf_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Then
$$\delta_Y(y)=\delta_X(f(y))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(y))}\kappa(y)$$
is a dimension function [def-kun-transcendence-degree, def-weil-residue-field], and $f^!K$ has a natural pinned potential dualizing structure for $\delta_Y$. These pinnings respect composition under the right-adjoint transitivity isomorphism. In particular the normalization is carried by the actual exceptional pullback, not merely by some isomorphic unnormalized dualizing object.
